name: X Poll Posts
description: Poll own posts via X API v2 (Owned Read) and enqueue to runner queue for drain.
prerequisite: X_ACCOUNTS (src/lib/constants/integrations.ts) lists the handles, each with its OAuth JSON file x-<handle>-oauth2.json in X_OAUTH_DIR. With no args the job covers every X_ACCOUNTS handle (see x/README.md)
